purpose: test whether Q1's two-name cohort works differently when diffusion leadership is concentrated in one PIT industry versus split across two

frozen_states.SAME_INDUSTRY: both exact Q1 names share the same signal-date PIT industry
frozen_states.TWO_INDUSTRIES: the two exact Q1 names have different signal-date PIT industries

required_views: decision dates, trades, mean cohort payoff, trade median, winner and severe-loss fraction
promotion_condition: only a state with negative mean cohort payoff in both chronological blocks, adequate support in both, and worse severe-loss incidence may motivate one separately frozen admission-veto replay
prohibited: diffusion-score gap, industry-count, threshold, or neighboring taxonomy search
within-pair Top-1 selection or weighting change
